summary.text: One of the forty-four suitors from Zacynthus in Apollodorus' island catalogue — a namesake of Evenorides in the Epitome 7.27 list, whom Apollodorus assigns to a different island roll.

story.text: Apollodorus names Evenorides among the wooers assigned to Zacynthus, listed after Periallus and before Clytius in Epitome 7.29.
The same patronymic appears in Epitome 7.27 among a different island catalogue — not to be merged with `evenorides-ithaca` without resolving Apollodorus' separate lists.
